```{r import and process site-level-summaries}
# Load unexploded per‐site stats
sites <- read_tsv("DMP.full.vcf.tsv", col_types = cols(
  CHROM          = col_character(),
  POS            = col_integer(),
  ID             = col_character(),
  NUM_ALTS       = col_integer(),
  SITE_LABEL     = col_integer()
))

# Total number of sites
n_sites <- nrow(sites)
message("Total sites: ", n_sites)

# Number of sites per chromosome
sites_per_chr <- sites %>% 
  count(CHROM, name = "n_sites") %>% 
  arrange(desc(n_sites))

sites_per_chr %>% 
  print(n = Inf)
```

```{r Plot distribution of sites per chromosome, include=TRUE, fig.width=11/3, fig.height=8/3}
# Plot: sites per chromosome
ggplot(sites_per_chr %>% mutate(n_sites_m = n_sites / 1e6),
       aes(y = fct_reorder(CHROM, n_sites_m), x = n_sites_m)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#0072B2") +
  labs(
    title = "Number of Sites per Chromosome",
    y = "Chromosome",
    x = expression(Sites~"(×10"^6*")")
  ) +
  JFMVTheme +
  scale_x_continuous(expand=c(0,0), limits=c(0, 4), 
                     breaks=seq(0, 3, 0.5)) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12)
  )->p1

p1

# save as svg
ggsave("sites_per_chr.svg", p1, width = 11/3, height = 8/3, units = "in", dpi = 300)
```

```{r generate num alts per site frequency table}
sites %>% 
  count(NUM_ALTS) %>% 
  arrange(desc(NUM_ALTS)) %>% 
  mutate(
    NUM_ALTS = factor(NUM_ALTS, levels = unique(NUM_ALTS)),
    NUM_ALTS = fct_reorder(NUM_ALTS, n)
  ) -> num_alts_per_site

# factor order from NUM_ALTS by numerical value
num_alts_per_site$NUM_ALTS <- factor(num_alts_per_site$NUM_ALTS,
                                      levels = num_alts_per_site$NUM_ALTS[order(as.numeric(levels(num_alts_per_site$NUM_ALTS)))])
```

```{r Distribution of ALTs per site, include=TRUE, fig.width=12/3, fig.height=8/3}

labs(title = "Distribution of ALT Alleles per Site",

scale_y_continuous(expand=c(0,0), limits=c(0, max(num_alts_per_site$n)*1.1/1e6)) +
```

```{r Summary of variant classes, include=TRUE, fig.width=11/1, fig.height=8/2}
sites %>% 
  count(VARIANT_CLASSES) %>% 
  arrange(desc(n)) %>% 
  mutate(
    VARIANT_CLASSES = factor(VARIANT_CLASSES, levels = unique(VARIANT_CLASSES)),
    VARIANT_CLASSES = fct_reorder(VARIANT_CLASSES, n)
  ) -> variant_classes

# For the purposes of this plot, replace COMPOSITE with INDEL
variant_classes$VARIANT_CLASSES <- str_replace_all(variant_classes$VARIANT_CLASSES, "COMPOSITE", "INDEL")

# For any duplicate VARIANT_CLASSES values, sum the counts
variant_classes <- variant_classes %>%
  group_by(VARIANT_CLASSES) %>%
  summarise(n = sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

# describe the variant classes
# How many unique variant classes are there?
n_unique_classes <- variant_classes %>%
  summarise(n = n_distinct(VARIANT_CLASSES)) %>%
  pull(n)
message("Unique variant classe patterns: ", n_unique_classes)

# sum patterns that are the same elements in different order (i.e. "SNV,INDEL" and "INDEL,SNV")
## to do this I need to first take the string, split it by ",", sort the elements, and then paste them back together
variant_classes <- variant_classes %>%
  mutate(
    VARIANT_CLASSES = str_split(VARIANT_CLASSES, ","),
    VARIANT_CLASSES = map_chr(VARIANT_CLASSES, ~ paste(sort(.x), collapse = ",")),
    VARIANT_CLASSES = factor(VARIANT_CLASSES, levels = unique(VARIANT_CLASSES)),
    VARIANT_CLASSES = fct_reorder(VARIANT_CLASSES, n)
  )
## for any duplicate VARIANT_CLASSES values, sum the counts
variant_classes <- variant_classes %>%
  group_by(VARIANT_CLASSES) %>%
  summarise(n = sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

# To simplify plotting add column replace INDEL with I, SNV with S, and MNV with M
variant_classes$ClassSig<-variant_classes$VARIANT_CLASSES
variant_classes$ClassSig<-str_replace_all(variant_classes$ClassSig, "INDEL", "I")
variant_classes$ClassSig<-str_replace_all(variant_classes$ClassSig, "SNV", "S")
variant_classes$ClassSig<-str_replace_all(variant_classes$ClassSig, "MNV", "M")

# For each VARIANT_CLASSES compress string, so if there are mutliple of the same class in the same pattern, it will be compressed to a single letter and a number of occurrences. So "I,I,I,I,I,I,I,I,I,I,I" will be compressed to "I10" and "I,I,I,I,I,M,M,M" will be compressed to "I5M3"
## to do this I need to first take the string, split it by ",", count the number of occurrences of each element, and then paste them back together
variant_classes <- variant_classes %>% 
  mutate(
    ClassSig = map_chr(VARIANT_CLASSES, ~ {
      alleles <- str_split(.x, ",")[[1]]      # split into vector
      cnts    <- table(alleles)               # count each unique
      paste0(names(cnts), cnts, collapse = "")  # e.g. "INDEL5MNV3SNV2"
    })
  )

## Now replace INDEL with I, SNV with S, and MNV with M
variant_classes$ClassSig<-str_replace_all(variant_classes$ClassSig, "INDEL", "I")
variant_classes$ClassSig<-str_replace_all(variant_classes$ClassSig, "SNV", "S")
variant_classes$ClassSig<-str_replace_all(variant_classes$ClassSig, "MNV", "M")

# Sort by n (largest to smallest)
variant_classes <- variant_classes %>%
  arrange(desc(n))

# How many of those make up 99% of the data? if sorted by n, from largest to smallest how entries does it take to reach 99% of the data?
variant_classes <- variant_classes %>%
  arrange(desc(n)) %>%
  mutate(
    Percent_n = n / sum(n) * 100,
    Cumulative_Percent = cumsum(Percent_n)
  )
message("Variant classes that make up 99% of the data: ", 
        sum(variant_classes$Cumulative_Percent < 99)+1)

# save the variant_classes data frame to file
write_tsv(variant_classes, "variant_pattern_count_table.tsv")

# Order the ClassSig column by the order of the n column
variant_classes$ClassSig <- factor(variant_classes$ClassSig, 
                                    levels = variant_classes$ClassSig[order(variant_classes$n, decreasing = TRUE)])

# Plot: variant classes for patterns that make up 99% of the data
ggplot(variant_classes[1:(sum(variant_classes$Cumulative_Percent < 99.9)+1),], aes(x = ClassSig, y = n/1e6)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#0072B2") +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Variant Classes",
       x = "Variant Class", y = expression(Sites~"(×10"^6*")")) +
  JFMVTheme +
  scale_y_continuous(expand=c(0,0), limits=c(0, max(variant_classes$n)*1.1/1e6)) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12)
  ) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = paste0(round(Percent_n, 2), "%")),
    size = 3,
    nudge_x = 0.4,
    nudge_y = 0.5,
    segment.size = 0.2,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) -> p3

p3

# Save as svg
ggsave("variant_classes.svg", p3, width = 11/1, height = 8/2, units = "in", dpi = 300)

ggplot(
  variant_classes[1:(sum(variant_classes$Cumulative_Percent < 99.9)+1), ],
  aes(x = ClassSig, y = n/1e6)
) +
  geom_col(fill = "#0072B2") +
  labs(
    title =    "Breakdown of Variant Class Patterns",
    x =        "Variant Class",
    y =        expression(Sites~"(×10"^6*")")
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand=c(0,0), limits=c(0, max(variant_classes$n)*1.1/1e6)) +
  JFMVTheme +
  theme(
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12)
  ) +
  scale_y_break(
      c(2, 3),         # drop the region from 3 to 22 (in millions)
      scales = 0.3     # relative size of the gap
  ) + 
  # add repelled text labels with percentage
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = paste0(round(Percent_n, 2), "%")),
    size = 3,
    nudge_x = 0.5,
    nudge_y = 0.5,
    segment.size = 0.2,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) -> p4

p4

# Save as svg
ggsave("variant_classes_breakdown.svg", p4, width = 11/1, height = 8/2, units = "in", dpi = 300)

```

```{r prep to upset plot count of variant classes by ALT count}
# add columns for number of ALT alleles per site
variant_classes$ALT_Count <- str_count(variant_classes$VARIANT_CLASSES, "I") +
  str_count(variant_classes$VARIANT_CLASSES, "M") +
  str_count(variant_classes$VARIANT_CLASSES, "S")

# Add column with combination fo SNV, INDEL, MNV label. S1 becomes "SNV", I1M1 becomes "INDEL + MNV", I1 becomes "INDEL", S1M1 becomes "SNV + MNV", S1I1M1 becomes "SNV + INDEL + MNV", etc. Using grepl to find the pattern
variant_classes$ClassMix <- variant_classes$VARIANT_CLASSES

variant_classes$ClassMix<-paste0(
ifelse(grepl("SNV", variant_classes$ClassMix),"SNV+",""),
ifelse(grepl("INDEL", variant_classes$ClassMix),"INDEL+",""),
ifelse(grepl("MNV", variant_classes$ClassMix),"MNV+","")
)


# remove any trailing "+" from the ClassMix column
variant_classes$ClassMix<-str_replace(variant_classes$ClassMix, "\\+$", "")

# Create thresholded Allele count
variant_classes$ALT_Count_Group<-variant_classes$ALT_Count
# if ALT_Count_Group == 1, then set to "2 alleles"
variant_classes$ALT_Count_Group<-ifelse(variant_classes$ALT_Count==1, "2 alleles", variant_classes$ALT_Count_Group)
# if ALT_Count_Group == 2, then set to "3 alleles"
variant_classes$ALT_Count_Group<-ifelse(variant_classes$ALT_Count==2, "3 alleles", variant_classes$ALT_Count_Group)
# if ALT_Count_Group > 3, then set to ">3 alleles"
variant_classes$ALT_Count_Group<-ifelse(variant_classes$ALT_Count>=3, ">3 alleles", variant_classes$ALT_Count_Group)

# add n merging the same ClassMix and ALT_Count_Group
variant_classes_summed_counts <- variant_classes %>%
  group_by(ClassMix, ALT_Count_Group) %>%
  summarise(n = sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()


# Order the ClassMix column by the order of the n column
variant_classes_summed_counts$ClassMix <- factor(variant_classes_summed_counts$ClassMix, 
                                                  levels = unique(variant_classes_summed_counts$ClassMix[order(variant_classes_summed_counts$n, decreasing = TRUE)]))

# Order the ALT_Count_Group column by "2 alleles", "3 alleles", ">3 alleles"
variant_classes_summed_counts$ALT_Count_Group <- factor(variant_classes_summed_counts$ALT_Count_Group, 
                                                          levels = c(">3 alleles", "3 alleles", "2 alleles"))

variant_classes_summed_counts %>% 
  print(n = Inf)
```

```{r combine nested class}
# The INDEL+MNV counts should be added to the INDEL counts and to the MNV counts. So they are double counted.
sum(variant_classes_summed_counts$n)
## INDEL & 3 alleles
variant_classes_summed_counts$n[variant_classes_summed_counts$ClassMix=="INDEL" & variant_classes_summed_counts$ALT_Count_Group=="3 alleles"]<-variant_classes_summed_counts$n[variant_classes_summed_counts$ClassMix=="INDEL" & variant_classes_summed_counts$ALT_Count_Group=="3 alleles"]+variant_classes_summed_counts$n[variant_classes_summed_counts$ClassMix=="INDEL+MNV" & variant_classes_summed_counts$ALT_Count_Group=="3 alleles"]
## INDEL & >3 alleles
variant_classes_summed_counts$n[variant_classes_summed_counts$ClassMix=="INDEL" & variant_classes_summed_counts$ALT_Count_Group==">3 alleles"]<-variant_classes_summed_counts$n[variant_classes_summed_counts$ClassMix=="INDEL" & variant_classes_summed_counts$ALT_Count_Group==">3 alleles"]+variant_classes_summed_counts$n[variant_classes_summed_counts$ClassMix=="INDEL+MNV" & variant_classes_summed_counts$ALT_Count_Group==">3 alleles"]
## MNV & 3 alleles
variant_classes_summed_counts$n[variant_classes_summed_counts$ClassMix=="MNV" & variant_classes_summed_counts$ALT_Count_Group=="3 alleles"]<-variant_classes_summed_counts$n[variant_classes_summed_counts$ClassMix=="MNV" & variant_classes_summed_counts$ALT_Count_Group=="3 alleles"]+variant_classes_summed_counts$n[variant_classes_summed_counts$ClassMix=="INDEL+MNV" & variant_classes_summed_counts$ALT_Count_Group=="3 alleles"]
## MNV & >3 alleles
variant_classes_summed_counts$n[variant_classes_summed_counts$ClassMix=="MNV" & variant_classes_summed_counts$ALT_Count_Group==">3 alleles"]<-variant_classes_summed_counts$n[variant_classes_summed_counts$ClassMix=="MNV" & variant_classes_summed_counts$ALT_Count_Group==">3 alleles"]+variant_classes_summed_counts$n[variant_classes_summed_counts$ClassMix=="INDEL+MNV" & variant_classes_summed_counts$ALT_Count_Group==">3 alleles"]

# Remove the INDEL+MNV counts
variant_classes_summed_counts<-variant_classes_summed_counts[variant_classes_summed_counts$ClassMix!="INDEL+MNV",]

# will be higher than the original sum because INDEL+MNV counts were added to both INDEL and MNV counts
sum(variant_classes_summed_counts$n)

# save to file for later re-plotting
write_tsv(variant_classes_summed_counts, "variant_classes_summed_counts.tsv")
```

```{r prepare variant compositon for ternary plot}
variant_comp <- variant_classes %>%
  mutate(
    pattern = str_split(VARIANT_CLASSES, ","),
    SNV   = map_dbl(pattern, ~ sum(.x == "SNV")   / length(.x)),
    INDEL = map_dbl(pattern, ~ sum(.x == "INDEL") / length(.x)),
    MNV   = map_dbl(pattern, ~ sum(.x == "MNV")   / length(.x))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(SNV, INDEL, MNV, n)

# for any duplicate VARIANT_CLASSES values, sum the counts
variant_comp <- variant_comp %>%
  group_by(SNV, INDEL, MNV) %>%
  summarise(n = sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

# calculate Percent_n
variant_comp$Percent_n<-(100*variant_comp$n/sum(variant_comp$n))

# sort by Percent_n
variant_comp <- variant_comp %>%
  arrange(desc(Percent_n))

variant_comp %>% 
  print(n = Inf)
```

```{r summarize SITE_LABEL values}
# Convert SITE_LABEL which is a bit-wise integer to binary {SNV: 1, INDEL: 2, COMPOSITE: 4, MNV: 8, GAP: 16}
# So a site label of 1 mean {SNV: True, INDEL: False, COMPOSITE: False, MNV: False, GAP: False}
# A site label of 3 means {SNV: True, INDEL: True, COMPOSITE: False, MNV: False, GAP: False}

site_labels <- sites %>%
  count(SITE_LABEL) %>%
  arrange(desc(n)) %>%
  mutate(
    SITE_LABEL = factor(SITE_LABEL, levels = unique(SITE_LABEL)),
    SITE_LABEL = fct_reorder(SITE_LABEL, n),
    # decode each bit
    has_SNV       = bitwAnd(as.integer(as.character(SITE_LABEL)), 1)  > 0,
    has_INDEL     = bitwAnd(as.integer(as.character(SITE_LABEL)), 2)  > 0,
    has_COMPOSITE = bitwAnd(as.integer(as.character(SITE_LABEL)), 4)  > 0,
    has_MNV       = bitwAnd(as.integer(as.character(SITE_LABEL)), 8)  > 0,
    has_GAP       = bitwAnd(as.integer(as.character(SITE_LABEL)), 16) > 0
  )

site_labels %>% 
  print(n = Inf)
```

```{r upset-plot, include=TRUE, fig.width=11/2, fig.height=8/2}
# Select only the logical columns + the site‐count
upset_df <- site_labels %>%
  dplyr::select(
    has_SNV, has_INDEL, has_COMPOSITE, has_MNV, has_GAP, n
  )

sum(upset_df$n)

# if has_INDEL is TRUE or has_COMPOSITE is TRUE, then has_INDEL should be TRUE, then remove has_COMPOSITE. This to treat COMPOSITE as INDEL
upset_df <- upset_df %>%
  mutate(
    has_INDEL = ifelse(has_COMPOSITE, TRUE, has_INDEL),
    has_COMPOSITE = NULL
  )

# duplicate rows has_SNV:has_GAP should have their n values summed and leave only one entry
upset_df <- upset_df %>%
  group_by(has_SNV, has_INDEL, has_MNV, has_GAP) %>%
  summarise(n = sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

sum(upset_df$n)

# conver 3 logical columns to a single column where has_SNV should be "S" if TRUE, and "" if FALSE. Then has_INDEL should be "I" if TRUE, and "" if FALSE. Then has_MNV should be "M" if TRUE, and "" if FALSE.
## the resulting column should be "SIM" if all are TRUE, "SI" if has_SNV and has_INDEL are TRUE, "S" if only has_SNV is TRUE, "I" if only has_INDEL is TRUE, "M" if only has_MNV is TRUE, and "" if all are FALSE

upset_df <- upset_df %>%
  mutate(
    ClassMix = paste0(
      ifelse(has_SNV, "S", ""),
      ifelse(has_INDEL, "I", ""),
      ifelse(has_MNV, "M", "")
    )
  )

# Order ClassMix by the order of n column (largest to smallest)
upset_df$ClassMix <- factor(upset_df$ClassMix, 
                             levels = unique(upset_df$ClassMix[order(upset_df$n, decreasing = TRUE)]))

ggplot(upset_df, aes(x = ClassMix, y = n/1e6, fill = has_GAP)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(title = "Breakdown of Variant Classes",
       x = "Variant Class", y = expression(Sites~"(×10"^6*")")) +
  scale_x_discrete(expand=c(0,0)) +
  JFMVTheme +
  scale_y_continuous(expand=c(0,0), limits=c(0, max(upset_df$n)*1.1/1e6)) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12)
  ) +
  # replace has_GAP with "N" and "No N"
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "N present in allele",
    values = c("TRUE" = "#D55E00", "FALSE" = "#0072B2"),
    labels = c("TRUE" = "Yes", "FALSE" = "No")
  ) +
  # replace S with "SNV", I with "INDEL", and M with "MNV"
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = c(
      "S" = "SNV",
      "I" = "INDEL",
      "M" = "MNV",
      "SI" = "SNV + INDEL",
      "SM" = "SNV + MNV",
      "IM" = "INDEL + MNV",
      "SIM" = "SNV + INDEL + MNV"
    )
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  # add repelled text labels with percentage
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = round(n/1e6,3) ),
    size = 3,
    nudge_x = 0.25,
    nudge_y = 1.5,
    segment.size = 0.2,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) -> p7

p7

# Save as svg
ggsave("breakdown_count_of_class_and_gapped.svg", p7, width = 11/2, height = 8/2, units = "in", dpi = 300)

# Spread the has_GAP column to columns
upset_df_wide <- upset_df %>%
  mutate(
    has_GAP = ifelse(has_GAP, "Yes", "No")
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = has_GAP,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  )

# Calculate percentage of GAP
upset_df_wide <- upset_df_wide %>%
  mutate(
    Gapped = Yes / (Yes + No) * 100
  )

# Calculate percentage of NotGAP
upset_df_wide$NotGapped <- 100-upset_df_wide$Gapped

# Gather the data back to long format
upset_df_long <- upset_df_wide %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Gapped, NotGapped),
    names_to = "GAP",
    values_to = "Percent"
  )


upset_df_long$GAP<-factor(upset_df_long$GAP, levels = c("NotGapped", "Gapped"), order=TRUE)

# Plot: upset plot with Gapped and NotGapped
ggplot(upset_df_long, aes(x = ClassMix, y = Percent, fill = GAP)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(title = "Breakdown of Variant Classes",
       x = "Variant Class", y = "%Loci with Ns") +
  scale_x_discrete(expand=c(0,0)) +
  JFMVTheme +
  scale_y_continuous(expand=c(0,0), limits=c(0, 100)) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12)
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  # replace has_GAP with "N" and "No N"
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "N present in allele",
    values = c("Gapped" = "#D55E00", "NotGapped" = "#0072B2"),
    labels = c("Gapped" = "Yes", "NotGapped" = "No")
  ) +
  # replace S with "SNV", I with "INDEL", and M with "MNV"
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = c(
      "S"   = "SNV",
      "I"   = "INDEL",
      "M"   = "MNV",
      "SI"  = "SNV + INDEL",
      "SM"  = "SNV + MNV",
      "IM"  = "INDEL + MNV",
      "SIM" = "SNV + INDEL + MNV"
    )
  ) +
  # add repelled text labels with percentage
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = paste0(round(Percent, 2), "%")),
    size = 3,
    nudge_x = 0,
    nudge_y = 0,
    segment.size = 0.2,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) -> p8

p8

# Save as svg
ggsave("breakdown_percent_of_class_and_gapped.svg", p8, width = 11/2, height = 8/2, units = "in", dpi = 300)
```

```{r load site exploded data}
# Load exploded per‐site stats
exploded_sites <- read_tsv("DMP.full.vcf.exploded.tsv")

exploded_sites<-exploded_sites[,-4]

colnames(exploded_sites)[1]<-"CHROM"
```

```{r How many sites}
# Total number of sites
n_exploded_sites <- nrow(exploded_sites)
message("Total exploded sites: ", n_exploded_sites)

# Number of sites per chromosome
exploded_sites_per_chr <- exploded_sites %>% 
  count(CHROM, name = "n_exploded_sites") %>% 
  arrange(desc(n_exploded_sites))

print(exploded_sites_per_chr) %>% 
  print(n = Inf)

# Add a column with whether the site has a gap or not
exploded_sites$GAP<-exploded_sites$ALT_NS>0

# Replace the NA in N_EQUIV with "No Gap"
exploded_sites$N_EQUIV[is.na(exploded_sites$N_EQUIV)]<-"No Gap"
# Replace True with "Equivalent gap"
exploded_sites$N_EQUIV[exploded_sites$N_EQUIV=="True"]<-"Equivalent"
# Replace False with "Not equivalent gap"
exploded_sites$N_EQUIV[exploded_sites$N_EQUIV=="False"]<-"Not equivalent"

# What fraction of sites have a gap?
exploded_sites %>%
  group_by(GAP) %>%
  summarise(n = n()) %>%
  mutate(Percent = n / sum(n) * 100) %>%
  ungroup() -> gap_summary

gap_summary %>% 
  print(n = Inf)

# What fraction of gapped sites could be equivalent to other segments if treated as wildcard?
exploded_sites %>%
  group_by(N_EQUIV) %>%
  summarise(n = n()) %>%
  mutate(Percent = n / sum(n) * 100) %>%
  ungroup() -> gap_equivalence_summary

gap_equivalence_summary %>% 
  print(n = Inf)
```

```{r plot gap equivalence, include=TRUE, fig.width=11/2, fig.height=8/2}
ggplot(gap_equivalence_summary, aes(x = N_EQUIV, y = Percent)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#0072B2") +
  labs(title = "Gap Equivalence",
       x = "Gap Equivalence", y = "% Alleles") +
  scale_x_discrete(expand=c(0,0)) +
  JFMVTheme +
  scale_y_continuous(expand=c(0,0), limits=c(0, max(gap_equivalence_summary$Percent)*1.1)) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12)
  ) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = paste0(round(Percent, 2), "%")),
    size = 3,
    nudge_x = 0.25,
    nudge_y = 4,
    segment.size = 0.2,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) -> p9

p9

# Save as svg
ggsave("gap_equivalence.svg", p9, width = 11/2, height = 8/2, units = "in", dpi = 300)
```

```{r simple-ternary, include=TRUE, fig.width=11/2, fig.height=8/2}
library(ggtern)
library(scales)

ggtern(variant_comp, 
       aes(x = SNV, y = INDEL, z = MNV, 
           size  = n,     # point‐size in millions
           color = n)) +      # map color to the raw counts
  geom_point(alpha = 1, stroke=0) +
  # viridis color scale with log2 transformation
  scale_color_viridis_c(
    name      = "Sites (log2)", 
    trans     = "log2",
    labels    = label_number(scale = 1),
    end=0.8,
    begin=0.1,
    option="turbo"
  ) +
    scale_size(
    name      = "Sites",
    range = c(1, 6),
    labels    = label_number(scale = 1)
  ) +
  labs(
    x     = "SNV",
    y     = "INDEL",
    z     = "MNV"
    ) +
  theme_minimal()

```
